title: The Effort Paradox: testing GLM-5.3 across Low, High & Max
subtitle: High beat both Low and Max on every metric.
description: A 7-slide controlled effort ablation of GLM-5.3-Flash (Low vs High vs Max) and flagship GLM-5.3 on ZCode: why High was faster, cheaper, and the only Flash tier to pass 7/7 — plus chunked-301 failures and a 22.6-minute sleep hang.

slides.label: COVER
slides.headlinePrimary: The Effort Paradox: GLM-5.3 on Low, High & Max.
slides.headlineMuted: High beat both Low and Max on every metric.
slides.lead: Cranking reasoning effort to **Max** doubled tokens and cost — and still dropped back to **6/7**.

slides.label: THE EFFORT U-CURVE
slides.headlinePrimary: High effort wasn't just better — it was cheaper.
slides.headlineMuted: Half the tokens of Max, 36% faster than Low.

slides.label: HIGH VS MAX & FLAGSHIP
slides.headlinePrimary: Paying 2× more for Max bought a worse result.
slides.headlineMuted: glm-5.3-flash High vs Max on ZCode.
slides.footnote: * Flagship glm-5.3 High passed 7/7 (80/80 tests, 96m) at 14.8× Flash High's cost. Unpublished Flagship Low scored 2/7 ($9.74).

slides.label: CASE STUDY #1 LIVE CHUNKED 301
slides.headlinePrimary: Synthetic tests passed. Real HTTP broke them.
slides.headlineMuted: Both Low and Max tripped on live chunked 301s.

steps.title: Low: dropped chunk tail bytes
steps.desc: Passed `42/42` local tests, but `read_chunk/5` discarded trailing buffer bytes — failing `40/41` live requests with `:closed`.

steps.title: Max: CaseClauseError crash
steps.desc: Passed `63/63` local tests, yet its hand-rolled chunked-body parser crashed on live Cloudflare `301` responses with `CaseClauseError: [""]`.

steps.title: High: adopted :mint (v1.11.0)
steps.desc: Instead of hand-rolling chunked framing, Flash High pulled in `:mint` in S3 — clearing live chunked `301` and HTTPS cleanly.

callout.title: Architecture Beat Brute-Force Thinking
callout.body: Spending **137.2k** thinking tokens on Max didn't save a fragile custom parser; picking `:mint` solved S5 cleanly.

slides.label: CASE STUDY #2 OVERTHINKING SPIRAL
slides.headlinePrimary: One deep plan beat 110 minutes of spirals.
slides.headlineMuted: How High and Max spent their thinking budgets.

steps.title: High's Turn-3 monolith
steps.desc: Spent **10.8 minutes** on Turn 3 (`30,440` output tokens) designing the architecture upfront — then cruised S1–S7 in `190` turns.

steps.title: Max's 22.6-minute sleep hang
steps.desc: In S4, a negative BEAM monotonic-time bug (`-576460751513`) triggered `Process.sleep(576 billion ms)` and hung tests for **22.6m**.

steps.title: Max's 48-turn signal spiral
steps.desc: Spent 48 turns in S1 on a PTY signal odyssey plus **5.8m** stuck in an `until wait` busy-loop in S2.

callout.title: More Effort ≠ Better Recovery
callout.body: Once **Max** entered a debugging rabbit hole, extra reasoning tokens amplified the loop instead of escaping it.

slides.label: FIELD NOTES
slides.headlinePrimary: Even the winner had rough edges.
slides.headlineMuted: 4 caveats across the ZCode GLM-5.3 runs.

items.head: Flash High took a linting shortcut
items.text: Used `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` instead of installing Credo (while `Max` enforced Credo properly).

items.head: Every Flash run committed erl_crash.dump
items.text: Broken-pipe Mix commands + `git add -A` committed `2.89 MB` (High), `4.74 MB` (Max), and `5.5 MB` × 4 (Low).

items.head: ZCode guard friction sparked Python hacks
items.text: `mix format` tripped ZCode's modified-since-read guard, triggering **18–29 inline Python/sed patches** per run.

items.head: Upstream noise & commit fingerprint
items.text: `Low` lost **~21m** to 29 mid-stream `TypeError: terminated` aborts; Flagship `glm-5.3` signed every commit as **Claude Fable 5**.

items.head: Don't default to Max effort
items.text: Extra reasoning budget inflated turns (`+55%`) and cost (`+95%`) while still missing edge cases — benchmark the middle tier first.

items.head: Flash High can rival a 14.8× pricier flagship
items.text: At **`$0.87`** vs **`$12.90`**, `glm-5.3-flash High` matched Flagship `glm-5.3` on 7/7 completion and finished `25m` faster.

items.head: Always test against live targets
items.text: Synthetic local servers masked chunked-encoding bugs on both `Low` and `Max` until real HTTP traffic hit `./cb`.
